name: rick-and-morty-microfrontends
description: App de microfrontends (shell + characters + character-detail) con Webpack Module Federation

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix apps/shell && npm install --prefix apps/characters && npm install --prefix apps/character-detail
scripts.dev:all: concurrently -n shell,characters,detail -c green,cyan,magenta "npm start --prefix apps/shell" "npm start --prefix apps/characters" "npm start --prefix apps/character-detail"
